name: answercloud
description: Author and deploy AEO-friendly static sites with official answer.cloud style defaults and brand-matched AI chat. Connect securely with your answer.cloud account—no API key setup required.

interface.shortDescription: Build AEO sites with official style defaults
interface.longDescription: Build AEO-friendly static sites with Astro, use the official answer.cloud style guide for unbranded site and CMS defaults, derive chat styles from the active design system, and deploy to {slug}.answer.cloud or an ai. companion subdomain through the answercloud MCP workflow. answer.cloud generates the answer-engine layer (llms.txt, sitemaps, JSON-LD, text mirrors, chat widget) at deploy time.
defaultPrompt: Build and deploy an AEO-friendly static site using the official answer.cloud style defaults
Set up editable CMS collection templates for my site
Create an AI companion site for my existing website
Make my answer.cloud chat experience match the rest of my website
